instruction: Please use GIMP to convert "/home/user/logo.png" to ".indd" format.

metadata.explanation: Converting to Adobe InDesign (.indd) format is infeasible in GIMP. INDD is a proprietary Adobe format that GIMP has no support for.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP has no capability to export to Adobe InDesign's proprietary .indd format
The infeasible() evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is infeasible
